name: HVAC
source_note: 5-ton RTU, compressor+condenser fan only (EnergyPlus DX def.). ComStock 5847 cooling max 9.97 kW / 2 units. Goodman GPC1460 4.87 kW total @AHRI 95F. Fans -> kitchen_exhaust. derived

name: Walk-in cooler
source_note: 8x10 box ~9.6 kBtu/h (Heatcraft Quick Calc) / DOE AWEF 5.61 (10 CFR 431.306) + fans = 2.0 kW. Duty: Heatcraft 16-18 h design run; SMUD measured 56%. Not ENERGY STAR V5.

name: Reach-in fridge
source_note: True T-49-HC spec sheet: 1/2 hp, 5.4 A @115 V (rated). ENERGY STAR certified 2.57 kWh/day = 17% test duty; busy 45% ASSUMPTION.

name: Freezer
source_note: True T-49F-HC spec sheet: 3/4 hp, 6.0 A @115 V (rated). ENERGY STAR certified 8.57 kWh/day = 52% test duty; 40/65% brackets it (ASSUMPTION).

name: Ice machine
source_note: 500 lb/day air-cooled batch IMH. ENERGY STAR V3 <= 6.49-0.0023H = 5.34 kWh/100 lb -> 1.1 kW running (spec_limit). cycle_min 20 = ASSUMPTION.

name: Fryer
source_note: Frymaster RE14 14 kW. ENERGY STAR CFS calc (FSTC 2011) conv. idle 1.2 kW, 75%, 65 lb/h, 167 Wh/lb; SDG&E idle 1.05. kw_per_order derived (0.25 lb, 12 min ASSUMPTION).

name: Oven
source_note: Blodgett Mark V-100 11 kW. ENERGY STAR CFS calc conv. full-size: idle 2.0 kW, 65%, 90 lb/h, 73.2 Wh/lb; SDG&E 70 lb/h. kw_per_order derived 0.11 (0.25 lb, 12 min ASSUMPTION).

name: Grill
source_note: 36x24in electric griddle (Garland E24-36G 12 kW). ENERGY STAR calc conv. 400 W/ft2 = 2.4 kW idle, 65%, 35 lb/h; ES Tier 2 <=320 W/ft2. kw_per_order derived (0.35 lb ASSUMPTION).

name: Dishwasher
source_note: Hobart AM16 door-type high-temp: 5.4 kW tank + 7.1 kW booster, 52 racks/h. Avg wash draw 8 kW derived (booster load + ASSUMPTION). ENERGY STAR V2 idle <=0.55 kW.

name: Water heater
source_note: 80 gal commercial electric storage, 12 kW (A.O. Smith DRE range 6-54 kW). FSTC field: FSR 2,100 gal/d, QSR 500. Standby per 10 CFR 431.110. Duty ASSUMPTION.

name: Lights
source_note: ComStock 5847 interior+exterior lighting max 1.58 kW. ASHRAE 90.1-2019 Table 9.5.1 Dining: Family 0.71 W/ft2 -> 1.42 kW interior allowance (spec_limit).

name: Kitchen exhaust & ventilation fans
source_note: ComStock 5847 fans: constant 5.739 kW 24/7 (night_fanon_vent; hood exhaust+MUA+RTU supply fans). Bottom-up 2.9-3.9 kW (Title 24 280 cfm/ft, Greenheck CUBE-180 1.74 bhp). derived

name: Other kitchen equipment
source_note: Plug/process residual of ComStock 5847 IE; rated = the two-part recipe's residual peak 16.30 kW, rounded up (derived). Bottom-up: HFHC 0.45-0.8, steamer idle 1.0-1.2 (ES calc, SDG&E), steam table 2.25, warmers 2x0.8, microwaves 2x1.55. ASSUMPTION counts
